# GitHub Copilot — Repo Instructions

All real instructions for this repo live in [`.ai/startup.instruction.md`](../.ai/startup.instruction.md). Read that file at the start of every session and follow it — this file exists only so Copilot finds an entry point at the location it expects; it carries no content of its own.

Do not duplicate `.ai/` content here. If something Copilot-specific ever needs to be said that doesn't apply to Claude or other AI clients, add it below this line — otherwise leave this file as a pure pointer.
